gen-press-start-2p-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its caps sitting barely taller than the lowercase around them. Paquito, a text serif, carries a long page easily, while Press Start 2P up top spreads its pinned-apart letters with a gentle, hard-to-spot thickening.
gen-righteous-fs-paquito: Paquito keeps its capitals hardly taller than its lowercase, which gives the text a confident, easygoing look. And Righteous, with bowls that fill the line and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, makes a longer read feel steady and friendly beneath it.
gen-silkscreen-fs-rowan: Friendly, with a literary streak, is how Rowan comes across, its curves opening wide and thin strokes at roughly half the thick ones. Rowan keeps a long stretch of reading lively through that moderate shift in thickness, while Silkscreen above it never swells or thins at all.
gen-gf-offside-switzer: Switzer has a Swiss, approachable feel, wire-like letterforms with a tall waist line and c tips that stay well apart. Switzer sits comfortably under Offside, whose widely tracked, curve-refusing letters feel expressive and bold against that tidy, tubular body.
gen-gf-metamorphous-general-sans: General Sans runs on one steady line weight, with an x-height that fills the line and smooth, unobstructed bends. General Sans is built for that clean, continuous texture, while Metamorphous does its best work in distinctive, widely spaced headings with a soft shift between fat and slim strokes.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-public-sans: Trustworthy first: Public Sans has a hefty lowercase with broad, open counters. Oxanium is at its best making a commanding statement, with dowel-like stems and bent-dowel arcs, while the plain sans below simply keeps text clear and professional.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, forming a thick, heavy-looking strip of text with letters held open rather than curled shut. Paprika scatters its capital-sized lowercase at a distance above it, so the plain sans below supplies the weight while the heading supplies the drama.
gen-unbounded-fs-bespoke-slab: Wide, round and welcoming, Unbounded spreads out its oversized lowercase and broad c openings, and Bespoke Slab follows with grounded, tall-bodied letters. Next to each other they feel friendly on top and refined below.
gen-gf-revalia-satoshi: Approachable is the first word for Satoshi, whose soaring x-height and wide-open e keep every ballpoint-thin stroke at one width. But Revalia is where the boldness lives, stretching widely separated letters in a relaxed stride that the plain sans body never tries to match.
gen-unbounded-fs-trench-slab: Unbounded spreads out, friendly and contemporary, with oversized lowercase. Its strongest quality is the way those generous, welcoming shapes sit above Trench Slab, a classic serif that keeps caps and lowercase close in height and feels dignified.
